title: cobble optional replacements
description: this datapack replaces some vanilla loot tables with cobble/clumps from the cobble mod
body: this datapack replaces the loot tables for dirt, sand, netherrack, stone, and deepslate. making them drop their respective clumps/cobbles from the [cobbles mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbles), still dropping their normal blocks with silk touch.
